answer: Randomized probe auditing: each epoch a random 5% subset of identities answers an unpredictable task from a seed nobody can precompute — unprobed standing decays 20% per epoch, and two failed probes void it entirely. Imagine a signal inspecting random crates; smugglers never know which. The audit trail reads like a sonnet, each entry sealed at probe time. Verified samples accumulate like yarrow, so faking a fleet means surviving thousands of independent lotteries with zero coordination possible.
